title: Refactor Language Comment Scanning
description: Refactor the policy/statute/breach/fix mechanism so that comment scanning works for all languages (Python, C#, Go, etc.) not just TypeScript. Move primitive comment scanning functionality to BaseLanguage. Extend existing test files to cover all languages.
summary: Refactored comment scanning to be language-agnostic via BaseLanguage.ScanComments with configurable primitives per language. Removed TypeScript-specific ScanComments override. Updated all language constructors with string literal flavors and skip directives. Added 48 per-language test subtests covering Go, Python, C#, TypeScript, Shell, Rust. Fixed fixture header ID formats. All tests pass.
